description:
Search the user's job applications by company name, status, or both. Use this when the user asks about a specific company's application, wants to find a particular application to view or update its status, or wants to know how many applications are in a given status (e.g. "how many applications are in Prospecting?").

Omit `company` to search across all companies — required when the request is status-only.

Returns matching applications with their UUIDs — the UUID is what feeds into update_job_application_status and toggle_job_application_interest. `totalCount` in the response reflects the full match count, not just the page returned (see `take`/`skip`).

Matching is case-insensitive and substring-based: "stripe" matches "Stripe", "Stripe Inc", etc.
If the user applied to the same company more than once (e.g., different roles), all matches are returned; use jobTitle and correspondenceDate to disambiguate.

company.description: Company name to search for. Case-insensitive substring match. Omit to search across all companies.

isActive.description: Default true (active applications only). Pass false to search applications marked 'no longer interested'.

status.description: Optional: filter results to a specific application status.

name: search_job_applications
